## Background

This epic grounds the thesis. It surveys three bodies of work: (1)
learning from demonstration for complex, long-horizon manipulation —
behavior cloning, action chunking, diffusion/flow policies; (2)
vision-language-action models — NVIDIA GR00T, and the Hugging Face
ecosystem (SmolVLA, π0, OpenVLA, LeRobot tooling); (3) assistive-robot
control relevant to OARbot. Output is an annotated bibliography in
`references.bib` and a Background chapter skeleton, plus the model
shortlist that [A2](../A2-task-suite-metrics/README.qmd) and the
policy-learning epics build on.
